note: A responsive length or shadow `$token` inside a responsive array now reads `var(--token)` instead of the token's first raw value: `px={['8px', null, '$containerX']}` showed the mobile `16px` at index 2 where the theme sets `--containerX` to `32px`, and `w={['$containerX']}` ignored theme variants such as `compact`. The slot still emits one class at its own breakpoint
